idea-plugin.name: Markdoc Language Service
idea-plugin.description:
Requires a JetBrains IDE 2026.1.4 or later with Node.js support.

Unofficial Markdoc integration built on the official @markdoc/language-server: tag and attribute completion, schema validation and syntax errors for .mdoc, .markdoc and *.markdoc.md files.

This plugin is not affiliated with Stripe or the Markdoc project.
